services.name: Whale Watching Tours
services.desc: 3.5 - 4 Hours Description Our daily whale watch trips are 3.5 to 4 hours in duration. (Trips are weather permitting.) We travel to different locations within Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary to view whales and dolphins throughout the year. Our crew will show you how to spot whales and dolphins as well as give you information on the wildlife and latest scientific information. The morning trip is the most highly advised departure of the day. Monterey can experience afternoon wind patterns, making the morning trip typically the calmest sea conditions of the day. What to Bring We 3 & 4 Hours • Morning, Afternoon, & Sunset Trips Available

quotes.author: Rudy G • Google Reviews
quotes.text: I love sightseeing, animals, biology, traveling and with Discovery Whale Watch, I got to experience all of that and more! Isaiah made it exceptionally fun with his personality and knowledge. Please please book this place as it will bring you tears of joy. Thank you to the captain and to Kenneth. Amazing crew!! Xoxo love from Texas

quotes.author: Kristin S • Google Reviews
quotes.text: We took the 1:30-4:30 pm Afternoon Whale Watch. Beautiful sunny day and plenty of Humpback Whales, sea lion “rafts” and a variety of sea birds. The crew—JJ, Maddy and Jesse—combined for storytelling, education, fun and importantly, they find the whales. We got a bonus with momma whale and baby calf together. Thank you, Discovery!

quotes.author: Mahima P • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Just completed a trip with you guys. We almost saw a group of 9 and then 5 and 3 and a single humpback whales totaling 18 humpback whales and a grey whale too. Thank you so much to Captain Andrew and Marine Biologist Andrew for their expertise that gave us amazing sightings. Love to come back.

quotes.author: Steve R • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Banner day with killer whales, pod of humpback whales feeding frenzy with breaching, sea lions and seagulls everywhere, capped off with a single humpback whales breaching 20+ times in close proximity. Captain and guide were excellent - felt very lucky to go out on a sunny spectacular day!

quotes.author: Alice W • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Knowledgeable, enthusiastic and professional guides. Good pacing, smooth navigation and multiple close sightings of humpbacks and dolphins! This was my second tour with Discovery Whale Watching. Highly Recommended!

quotes.author: Joanne B • Google Reviews
quotes.text: Isiah and Ryan wowed us with their whale knowledge and care for everyone on board. We were so fortunate to see whales lunge feeding and can’t wait to come back! Thanks for a great tour!
